\section[\texorpdfstring{\te{గుడిసె} (guḍise)}{గుడిసె (guḍise)}]{\te{గుడిసె} (guḍise) — a hut}

\label{lesson:TE-C292-gudise}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Telugu for opposite, then the Telugu for around.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \te{గుడిసె}}
\textbf{\te{గుడిసె}} — \emph{guḍise} — \textquotedblleft{}a hut\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\te{గుడిసె}} (\emph{guḍise}) is native Dravidian. DEDR 1655 lists \emph{guḍise}, \textquotedblleft{}hut, cottage\textquotedblright{}, with Kannada \emph{guḍisalu}, \textquotedblleft{}hut\textquotedblright{}, and Tamil \emph{kuṭical}, \textquotedblleft{}hut\textquotedblright{}. DEDR compares Sanskrit \emph{kuṭī}, \textquotedblleft{}hut\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 3232), which CDIAL partly takes from Dravidian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{guḍise}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{guḍise}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{guḍise}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Telugu for opposite, then the Telugu for around, then say \emph{guḍise} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\te{కాలువ} (kāluva)}{కాలువ (kāluva)}]{\te{కాలువ} (kāluva) — a canal}

\label{lesson:TE-C292-kaluva}

Before the new one: say the Telugu for around, then the Telugu for a hut.
\end{quote}

\textbf{\te{కాలువ}} — \emph{kāluva} — \textquotedblleft{}a canal\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\te{కాలువ}} (\emph{kāluva}) is native Dravidian. DEDR 1480 lists \emph{kāluva}, \textquotedblleft{}canal, channel\textquotedblright{}, with Kannada \emph{kāluve}, \textquotedblleft{}water-course\textquotedblright{}, and Tamil \emph{kāl}, \textquotedblleft{}irrigation channel\textquotedblright{}. DEDR compares Sanskrit \emph{khalla}, \textquotedblleft{}trench, canal\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 3849).
\end{cousinweb}

\textbf{\te{భవనం}} — \emph{bhavanaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}a building\textquotedblright{}.

\end{cousinweb}
